hash_method: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 file text after CRLF -> LF normalization, lowercase hex

registry_map_equals_BA-02a.detail: class, AFFECTED_GROUPS and IN_PREDICATE of every key of the JSON REGISTRY_MAP equal BA-02a V3 section 2 (V2.2 PA-1.2)

group_table_equals_BA-02a.detail: the JSON GROUP_TABLE equals BA-02a V3 section 3 (V2.2 PA-1.3)

v5_schema_fields_present.detail: every scenario has exactly the V5 schema fields (the V4 fields plus RUN_PREREQUISITES)

build_under_test_values.detail: NONE only for synthetic scenarios (REACH SYN)

group_fields_defined_in_ba04_section1_an.detail: AR4-17: GROUPS_SERVED and CONTRACT_ASSIGNED_GROUPS are defined normatively in BA-04 section 1 (and the JSON); BA-02b rule 1 applies that definition; no BA-04 -> BA-02b edge

groups_served_equals_definition_of_ba04_.detail: GROUPS_SERVED == ordered union of AFFECTED_GROUPS(CONTROLS_EXERCISED) then EVIDENCE_GROUPS_DECLARED; nothing else

contract_assigned_groups_admitted_source.detail: each entry is {group, clause}, a CONTROL group, never in GROUPS_SERVED; the clause cites the admitted source that fits the scenario (V2.1 10.8 for X7 cells; V2.1 10.6 and 21.4 for residual cells; V2.2 PA-12 for closure completeness; AR4-03 with V2.1 26.3 and 31 for KS-*); the verdict says never PASS

group_is_served_or_contract_assigned.detail: the primary GROUP is served or contract-assigned; HDM (not a PA-1.3 group) and the non-governing composition check EV-L-COMPOSED (AR4-01) are the declared exceptions

ar3_01_mode_ruled_scope.detail: the AR3-01 mode applies exactly to E4-LEARN-R1-*, LK-*, HDM-CHAR-*, WU-DRY-* (non-governing) and the Q-I14-* vehicles (governing, AR4-01): CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD, PROVISIONAL_NON_GOVERNING, CHARACTERIZATION_TUPLE; no EVM, HOST_DEFAULT_MAP, E-04 pin or K-3; no proposal label remains

ev_l_fields_ar4_01.detail: AR4-01: EV-L-OC-* governing E12-L on the PRODUCT_BUILD, the driver a declared harness DLL; RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED = E-04, E-12 phase A, E-12 phase C with the basis per control; E-03 enforced under LOCK_MODE; S-1..S-3 NOT_EVALUATED; outcome NONE; EV-L-COMPOSED non-governing, outside the corpus

per_build_qualification_twins.detail: AR4-06 (3): every Q-* and E6-C* outside the I-14 family has a twin <id>-CB on the CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD with the same expectation and a qualification tuple naming its build; the I-14 family runs only on the CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD; each instrument of V2.1 4.3 per build

characterization_tuple_profile_per_build.detail: AR4-06 (1), (2): one admissible BUILD_BOUND profile per build; CHARACTERIZATION_TUPLE with its own build-dependent fields

run_prerequisites_equivalence_and_qualif.detail: AR4-06 (4): BUILD_EQUIVALENCE_RECORD exactly on the PRODUCT_BUILD scenarios that consume E04_ADMITTED_SET, LOCK_MODE or HOST_DEFAULT_MAP; every I-14 record a rule resolves from is named (Q-I14-X, Q-I14-Y, Q-I14-SILENT-*); NC-E12A and NC-S5-O6 name Q-I14-Y (AR4-01, AR4-04, AR4-16); correction pass: every governing I-14 writer injection names its vehicle's record (X: Q-I14-X, Y: Q-I14-Y, between PR and PW: Q-I14-P, silent: Q-I14-SILENT-*); the REVIEWED_RECORD exactly on EV-L-*; the RUN_PREREQUISITE_RULE; correction pass (final): the BUILD_EQUIVALENCE_RECORD by pointer to BA-07 V5 (location, content schema and custody: sections 2, 4 and 5.3; use precondition: section 7, U5), no superseded in-catalog path or field names, U5 in the vocabulary, the citation rule and step 6 of 2.2, and BA-07 V5 holds what is pointed to

i14_records_only_on_characterization_bui.detail: V2.1 4.3 row I-14 and AR4-06 (6): a rule that resolves from an I-14 record is used only on the CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD; EA2-DEFERRED-EVENTS runs there

wu_dry_exactly_one_per_governing_window_.detail: the one rule of BA-09 section 4: every GOVERNING scenario of MODE CHARACTERIZATION_RUN or VALIDATION with REACH in P0..CP has exactly one WU-DRY-<id>; no other scenario has one; a dry run carries only the FIXTURE_INSTANCE slots of its source, WU_DRY_RUNS = N_B, the source injections (plus the branch switch where AR4-02 applies), the AR3-01 set, the source blockers K-8 and AQ-V5-08, the source REACH and "LP-DRY over" the source log

dry_run_branch_switches_ar4_02.detail: AR4-02: the dry run of each source whose refusal or abort comes from a RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED control takes the declared branch at the same checkpoint through the DRY_RUN_BRANCH_SWITCH, named in PLAN_OR_INPUT and INJECTIONS; REACH and profile as the source; no other dry run has it

dry_run_canary_load_exclusion_ar4_16.detail: AR4-16: the dry runs of the sources with a designed load injection (CANARY_LOAD, foreign-load HARNESS_FAULT) exclude the loads of the named assembly or module (declared identity), record them as STIMULUS_LOAD, count every other load; a warm-up revision never preloads it

flags_targets_designed_stimuli.detail: DESIGNED_STIMULUS != NONE => flag NO; flag YES => a registry control or INSTRUMENT:I-nn target; flag NO => target NONE

yes_target_result_names_the_failure.detail: AR2-09: the target control's expected result names its FAIL, UNKNOWN, difference or rejection

conditional_e12c_cells_target_e12c.detail: AR3-05: a scan cell whose detection is conditional on E-12 phase C (not a secondary channel) targets E12C

conditional_negative_controls_branch_dep.detail: AR4-16, AR4-20 (d), R1:BA02V4-N02: a conditional negative control gives a designed detection only on its detection branch; the target result on the non-detection branch is PASS with the scenario NOT_RUNNABLE as a negative control

nc_e12a_conditional_by_cer_wit.detail: AR4-16 (R1:BA04V4-04, R2:BA04V4-05): NC-E12A conditional by CER-WIT; the witness qualified for XDATA_WRITE at Y1

sealed_at_recomputes.detail: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization (sorted keys, UTF-8, separators "," and ":", no ASCII escaping) of the fields of SEALED_AT_RULE

sealed_at_fields.detail: the SEALED_AT fields are schema fields, exclude the derived ones, and include the group-attribution and repetition fields (R1:BA04V4-10, R2:BA04V4-09)

expected_outcome_kinds.detail: exact O1..O7, NONE, a declared conditional, PROVISIONAL_NON_GOVERNING or the outcome of the preceding run

pin_slots_rule.detail: section 2.1 of BA-04 V5 (E-04 pin only where the run reaches the P0 control evaluation)

k3_exactly_where_s1_s3_are_adjudicated.detail: governing host scenario outside the AR3-01 mode with REACH PV or CP

blocked_by_values.detail: BLOCKED_BY uses only K-3, K-8 and AQ-V5-08 (the open item on the admission of Q-I14-P; correction pass (final)): AQ-V4-01, AQ-V4-03, K-6 and E6-C4 are ruled (AR4-01, AR4-03, AR4-07, AR4-04)

aq_v5_08_exactly_on_q_i14_p_and_its_dry_.detail: correction pass (final): AQ-V5-08 is carried by Q-I14-P and WU-DRY-Q-I14-P only, after K-8 (status DRAFT), and the Q-I14-P NOTE and AR3_01_MODE.ruled_for name it

blockers_prerequisites_and_edges.detail: the section 1 vocabulary is K-3, K-8 and AQ-V5-08; section 7.1 lists K-3, K-8 and the Architect review (AQ-V5-08 among its items) and says which remain; the header PREREQUISITES names no ruled question; DEPENDS_ON adds BA-07 (BA-04) and BA-01 (BA-02b) (AR4-17)

param_03_sample.detail: the governing CL-CLEAN-<fixture> scenarios plus EA2-DEFERRED-EVENTS carry the CLEAN rule, and no other (AR3-24); EA2 valid for the product build only under the equivalence

repetition_label_equals_ba10_derivation.detail: the REPETITION label of every scenario is the first matching row of the BA-10 rule table (N_strict: N_A, N_B or max(N_A, N_B); CONTRACT_ASSIGNED_GROUPS excluded, AR4-14 (a); CHAR_RUNS with exactly one informative run per varied key, AR4-14 (b)(ii))

log_record_deltas_and_evidence_sets.detail: R1:BA04V4-03: INJECTION records for every injected scenario, WITNESS records where CER-WIT, CER-A2 or CER-PERSIST resolve, the POST_ABORT_READ record where CER-PERSIST resolves (and in Q-I14-Y); the evidence set names the I-14 records; every profile token is defined

correction_pass_consistency.detail: correction pass of round V5: HDM-CHAR-FXDIM excludes the writer-assigned dimension style; the driver DLL is in the one PRODUCT_BUILD profile (EV-L-* and EV-V-* use it); "Enforced, not exercised" is normative; Q-I14-P qualifies the PREPARE-phase coordinate; EV-L-COMPOSED's outcome; md 7.4 and C-10; md 8.1 AQ-V4-11 (in ruling_traces)

expected_result_keys_exercised_or_declar.detail: every registry key of EXPECTED_CONTROL_RESULTS is in CONTROLS_EXERCISED, or its value is NOT_DECLARED, or it is a control of the scenario's own RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED set with the value RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED, or, in an EV-L-* scenario only, a control it enforces with the value ENFORCED_NOT_EXERCISED (section 1; correction pass); no EV-L-* control expectation hides under a non-registry key

fpspec_vector_ids_and_outcomes.detail: Q-FPSPEC-VECTORS (and its twin) names exactVectors, rejectedInputs and semanticVectors, expects every DIGEST, UNKNOWN and REJECTED and the INVALID instance rule, binds the BA-08 SEAL_HASH; Q-SIGNED-ZERO cites EV-01, EV-02, SV-05, EV-06, EV-07, which hold those outcomes

no_stale_markers_and_equal_delta_ruling.detail: no "pending AQ-V4", no version-labelled BA-11 citation (AR4-17), no AQ-V4-01..07 carried as pending; the md header and the JSON hold the same DELTA_RULING_APPLIED; the contract line of round V5

ba02b_no_coverage_gap_except_declared_co.detail: every control is COVERED_DRAFT, or COVERED_DRAFT_CONDITIONAL (only conditional negative controls: NEGATIVE_CONTROL_NOT_EVALUATED at acceptance, AR3-03)

ba02b_characterization_build_dependency_.detail: R1:BA02V4-N03: the controls whose every counted negative control runs on the CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD are named (AR4-06)

ba02b_rule5_ar4_20_r3.detail: AR4-20 R-3 (a)..(d): per control; check 2 NOT MET; ALT21D_HOST_PASS NOT_EVALUATED, never TRUE; designed detection only on the detection branch

ba02b_group_coverage_recomputed.detail: contract-assigned scenarios are counted apart and never as serving, countable or governing-serving (R1:BA02V4-N06)

ba02b_section3_rows_verbatim.detail: the five cells of every row in effect equal the contract cells (V2.1 31: 22 rows incl. the four NOT_A_CONTROL rows; V2.2 PA-1.4: 7 rows)

ba02b_section3_discharges.detail: each clause is a verbatim fragment of its row; each listed scenario exists and is a class member (OU-O1..O7 strict) or one of the seven declared exceptions (the PR-TORN-READ rows removed, OU-ROW1-INVALID declared: R1:BA02V4-N05)

ba02b_section3_every_row_discharged.detail: every row has clauses and every clause has at least one non-exploratory scenario (MET_IN_DRAFT)

ba02b_section3_enumerated_sets_covered.detail: rule 6 (R1:BA02V4-N04): every clause quantified over an enumerated set covers every member, recomputed from V2.1 4.2, 4.3, 17.2, V2.2 PA-12, V2.1 10.6 and the catalog (I-01..I-16 and E6-C1..C8 per build; E6-C4 present, G-3); the conjunctive clause of R14 is split

ba02b_binds_this_check.detail: AR4-17 / R1:BA11V4-04: BA-02b section 0 names this check with its SHA-256 and binds the check and its output to the BA-02b entry of the registry, never to BA-04

delta_v5_tables_cover_the_findings.detail: every finding of the round for BA-04 and BA-02b (both passes, R1:/R2:) and every AR4 decision applied has a row in the Delta V5 table that ends each artifact
